data.title: OCEANZ by Danube Properties
data.about:
In the heart of Dubai Maritime City, Oceanz by Danube offers unrivalled luxury. This exquisite residence, designed by Lamborghini Tonino, sets a new standard for architecture in Oceanz Danube at Dubai Maritime City. 

Danube Oceanz offers a variety of studios and one- to three-bedroom apartments with private pools and elegant office spaces to suit your refined preferences. Discover luxurious living at Oceanic Villas, situated among stunning seaside views.

Danube Oceanz encourages you to live an immersed lifestyle of seaside calm and high-end luxury every day. Dive into a world where your wishes affect your surrounds, where your house is moulded to your whims, combining utility and elegance to fulfil your aspirations. Oceanz Danube at Dubai Maritime City begins your magnificent journey of living at the horizon.

location_tile.title: Located in Dubai Maritime City
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Nestled strategically along the city’s scenic coastline, it offers you an unrivaled visual treat, where each sunset paints a canvas of allure with golden hues, providing a living experience immersed in nature's mesmerizing artistry. Be captivated daily by the serene surroundings, as Oceanz by Danube brings you a home that is a haven of luxury, offering undisturbed views that are nothing short of a tranquil visual poetry, greeting you each day.

  • 05 Minutes from Mina Rashid
  • 20 Minutes from The Dubai Mall
  • 10 Minutes to Jumeirah Beach
